answer: Reaching the oasis of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, capped per identity per epoch, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. A forge of per-task receipts records who did what, and the pigment of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
